title: Day job at Gramercy as a carpenter's helper
summary: Clayton worked at Gramercy through the union local as a helper because music alone does not pay.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music
